//: Gate 1 of 3: shipped package source, in a deliberately Node-free and DOM-free program.
Only `packages/*` is included. `apps/*` moved to gate 3 (tsconfig.typecheck.app.json)
when the extension gained real browser code: the app needs `lib.dom` for IndexedDB,
and adding DOM here would have handed `document`, `window`, `localStorage`, and
`fetch` to capsule-schema and capsule-core, which Document 14 §2 requires to stay
platform-neutral. Two programs keep each boundary enforceable on its own terms.
Test files and vitest.config.ts are excluded here even though they must also
typecheck — gate 2 (tsconfig.typecheck.tests.json) covers those. The reason is that
importing `vitest` transitively loads vite's and @types/node's ambient declarations
into whichever program contains it, which hands `process`, `Buffer`, and the rest of
the Node global surface to every other file in that same program. `types: []` does
not prevent this, because those declarations arrive through a module import rather
Keeping shipped package source in its own program is what makes the boundary
enforceable: a `process.env` or `document` reference inside capsule-schema fails here.
Deliberately has no `paths` mapping: cross-package imports must resolve through real
pnpm workspace links, so a package that forgets to declare a dependency fails here
